SELECT b.item_id,
                SUM(s.on_hand_qty::numeric)*0.000001,
                SUM(CASE WHEN (b.expires_on IS NULL OR b.expires_on >= '2026-09-21'::date) AND i.is_active AND w.is_active THEN s.on_hand_qty::numeric ELSE 0 END)*0.000001,
                SUM(CASE WHEN b.expires_on < '2026-09-21'::date THEN s.on_hand_qty::numeric ELSE 0 END)*0.000001,
                SUM(s.on_hand_qty::numeric*b.unit_cost::numeric)*0.000000000001
                FROM labops_stockbalance s JOIN labops_batch b ON b.id=s.batch_id
                JOIN labops_item i ON i.id=b.item_id JOIN labops_warehouse w ON w.id=s.warehouse_id
                GROUP BY b.item_id
